measurements.sql: SELECT e.id,d.body FROM encrypted e JOIN session_keys k USING(id) JOIN short_projection s USING(id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT read_body(e.ciphertext,k.secret,e.id) AS body OFFSET 0) d WHERE e.id <= %s AND s.grams @> %s::text[] AND lower(d.body) LIKE %s ORDER BY e.id LIMIT 20
